texts: Calcification of the right ventricular outflow tract is not, by itself, an indication for intervention after repair of tetralogy of Fallot: C.
Calcium in a patch or conduit matters only if it causes obstruction or regurgitation.

Indications include severe pulmonary regurgitation with right ventricular dilation or dysfunction, a residual ventricular septal defect with left ventricular volume overload or dysfunction, and aortic root dilation with aortic regurgitation.
Arrhythmias such as atrial tachycardia also call for treatment and a search for residual lesions.
In the picture, the chalky spots on the funnel are left alone, while the four other faults are mended.
Memory hook: chalk on the funnel is left alone; leaks, holes and racing needles are mended.
